exclude.description: Globs never walked or analyzed; added to the defaults (node_modules, dist, build, coverage)

tests.description: Globs of test files (excluded, reason test)

generated.description: Globs of generated files (excluded, reason generated)

entries.description: Globs of framework or tool entry modules whose exports are a fixed contract (excluded, reason entry)

failThreshold.description: shallowScore at or above which a module is flagged and can fail the gate

tolerance.description: Score points a baselined module may worsen before G2 fails it

minInterfaceSize.description: Modules with a smaller interface are never flagged, unless pass-through or classitis

depthTarget.description: (statements + operations) per interface unit at which the depth component reaches 0

complexityTarget.description: Cyclomatic complexity per interface unit at which the complexity component reaches 0

classitisMinFiles.description: Minimum modules in a directory before classitis is considered

entries.description: Globs of framework or tool entry modules whose exports are a fixed contract (excluded, reason entry)
